description: This Java source file defines the 'MockThermostat' class, which extends 'MockZigbeeDevice' and implements 'BatteryPowered'. It creates a mock representation of a smart thermostat device with various clusters (thermostat, fan control, identify, groups, scenes, etc.) for testing purposes in a Zigbee-related system. The class provides methods to manipulate and access thermostat-specific attributes such as temperature setpoints, system mode, hold status, fan mode, and battery status.

classes.name: MockThermostat
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Zigbee thermostat device, providing control over temperature setpoints, modes, fan, and battery status for testing or simulation purposes.

methods.name: setHeatSetpoint
methods.description: Sets the heat temperature setpoint for the thermostat.

methods.name: getHeatSetpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the current heat temperature setpoint.

methods.name: setCoolSetpoint
methods.description: Sets the cool temperature setpoint for the thermostat.

methods.name: getCoolSetpoint
methods.description: Retrieves the current cool temperature setpoint.

methods.name: setSystemMode
methods.description: Sets the thermostat's system mode (e.g., heating, cooling).

methods.name: getSystemMode
methods.description: Returns the current system mode of the thermostat.

methods.name: setHoldOn
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the hold mode on the thermostat.

methods.name: getHoldOn
methods.description: Checks if hold mode is active.

methods.name: setFanMode
methods.description: Sets the fan mode (e.g., auto, on).
